title: Web view: edit the blueprint fields and start new tickets from the template
description: The ticket page now shows the blueprint sections (why, to do, acceptance criteria ...) and lets a person tick to-dos and criteria. Two things are still missing for people who work in the browser: the edit form only knows title, description, status, kind, priority and labels, and the create form does not start with the description template of the kind.
why: People using the web view do not see which expected fields of a ticket are empty; only the CLI shows it.

acceptance.text: The edit form can change why, to-dos and acceptance criteria
The create form starts with the description template of the chosen kind
Missing expected fields are named in the create form
